History
Schwarze Motorcycle Club also known as white supremacy encompasses post-World War II militant, social, and political movements that sought to revive and restore Nazi ideology. The Schwarze MC uses their ideology to promote hatred and racial supremacy often white supremacy to attack racial and ethnic minorities often antisemitism and Islamophobia, and in some cases to create fascist states. This motorbike club has one main rule, which is that black people are not allowed to join. Schwarze MC is known as a motorbike club with many criminal records and is also one of the strongest as some members of the club are former military troops.
Founded in 1998 by a former World War II military man, Philip Barker. Schwarze is not just another motorbike club but they are often involved in smuggling illicit goods, selling firearms, money laundering, extortion and imposing a tax system on local businesses that stand on their land. Schwarze is based in Las Colinas providing a strategic location close enough to the city centre for commerce, yet far enough away to evade the law. In 2018 Sinnerside managed to control most of the drug routes along the northeastern highway through their reputation for negotiating with large overseas suppliers and their reputation for keeping promises, Schwarze managed to take over most of the drug distribution routes northwest of Los Santos. They not only became the middlemen, but also the owners of these routes. One by one, small gangs were eliminated, either through bloody negotiations, forced takeovers, or betrayal from within. However, Schwarze ran into some trouble when the Los Santos Department stepped up surveillance, resulting in several Schwarze members being caught by the Department. However, Schwarze stood firm by recruiting new members and continuing its operations and defending its territory which was under attack from various problems.
